items.title: FDR /scam/ needs an advance-fee and impersonation block (DFPI hook)

items.why: FDR's /scam/ page still has no impersonation or advance-fee copy. The DFPI's September actions, published 12 Nov 2026, include E-Capital Inc. (ordered to stop charging upfront fees for debt-relief services it never performed) and Frontier Legal Group (fake lawsuits and wage-garnishment threats). Together with FTC Arizona and the GA AG, that is three states in three weeks. /scam/ is in the crawl as an 'other' page, so it rolls up to the FDR brand node (it is not a drawn product-hub page). Evidence Brief 2026-11-20: /scam/ still has 0 impersonation / advance-fee block while affinity look-alikes run (brand-confusion risk, not a violation) and state cases grow.
items.fix: Add an advance-fee and impersonation block to /scam/, using the DFPI E-Capital action as a hook. Compliance to word it.
